description: The smallest set the window needs. No http, no shell, no fs: the page itself has no capability to reach the network or the disk outside its own bundle. Reel Agent adds: notifications (the 06:30 'today's reel is ready'), launch-at-login on request, and its own Rust commands (system voice, a save dialog, and — only when the reader turns Connected mode on — HTTPS from Rust to three fixed AI hosts with the reader's key from the system keychain).
